bio.zh: 笛卡尔是法国哲学家、数学家与自然哲学家。他以方法怀疑重新追问知识的基础，论证心灵与身体的区分，也研究二者的统一及激情。他将形而上学、物理学与实践生活相联结，其著作和通信深刻影响了近代思想的形成。
bio.en: René Descartes was a French philosopher, mathematician, and natural philosopher. He used systematic doubt to investigate the foundations of knowledge, defended a distinction between mind and body, and also examined their union and the passions. His work connected metaphysics with the study of nature and practical life, helping to shape the questions of early modern philosophy.

bio.zh: 斯宾诺莎出生于阿姆斯特丹的葡萄牙犹太社群。他把人理解为自然的一部分，以唯一实体及其样式阐释世界，研究知识、情感与自由的关系。他以理性生活与幸福为伦理学目标，并通过对宗教和政治的考察，为思想自由与宽容辩护。
bio.en: Baruch Spinoza was born into Amsterdam’s Portuguese-Jewish community. He understood human beings as part of nature and explained reality through a single substance and its modes. His philosophy connects knowledge, emotion, freedom, and the pursuit of a flourishing life. His examination of religion and political authority also defended the freedom to think and philosophise.

attributionNote.en: This image belongs to the surviving portrait tradition of Spinoza. The Library’s conservation and X-ray record did not settle whether it was painted from life or is an early copy. It guides the reconstruction without establishing an exact historical likeness.

bio.zh: 莱布尼茨是德国哲学家、数学家与学者，其研究横跨逻辑、自然科学、法律和历史。他以充足理由原则、单子与前定和谐解释世界的秩序，思考可能性、自由与恶的问题。他的思想散见于论文、著作和广泛的学术通信之中。
bio.en: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz was a German philosopher and mathematician whose interests also included law, history, and natural science. He investigated the order of the world through sufficient reason, monads, and pre-established harmony, while considering possibility, freedom, and evil. His philosophy developed across books, short essays, and extensive correspondence rather than a single definitive systematic work.

dateNote.en: Composed in 1686; not the date of first publication.

bio.zh: 康德是德国哲学家，长期在柯尼斯堡生活与任教。他通过批判哲学考察经验知识的条件与理性的限度，以自主性说明道德与自由，并在审美和目的论中探索自然与自由的联系。他的三部《批判》持续影响认识论、伦理学与美学。
bio.en: Immanuel Kant was a German philosopher who lived and taught in Königsberg. His critical philosophy examined the conditions of experience and the limits of human knowledge. He placed autonomy at the centre of moral life and explored how judgments of beauty and natural purposes connect nature with freedom. His three Critiques remain central to epistemology, ethics, and aesthetics.

works.en: Critique of the Power of Judgment

bio.zh: 洛克是英国哲学家。他从感觉与反省考察观念的来源，区分知识与意见，并讨论人类理解的范围和限度。他的政治哲学重视自然权利、同意与政府权力的约束，也论述宗教宽容；这些问题使认识论与公共生活紧密相联。
bio.en: John Locke was an English philosopher who investigated the sources and limits of human understanding. He traced ideas to sensation and reflection and distinguished knowledge from opinion. His political writings examined natural rights, consent, and the limits of government, while his account of religious toleration addressed the relationship between conscience, civil authority, and peaceful coexistence.

dateNote.en: Issued in 1689 with 1690 on the title page.

bio.zh: 贝克莱是爱尔兰哲学家，曾任都柏林圣三一学院研究员和克洛因主教。他从感知与观念出发，批评独立于心灵的物质实体，提出以心灵及其观念为核心的非物质主义。他的研究还涉及视觉、自然科学、宗教与社会生活。
bio.en: George Berkeley was an Irish philosopher, a fellow of Trinity College Dublin, and later Bishop of Cloyne. His immaterialism challenged the idea of matter existing independently of minds and explained reality through minds and their ideas. His investigations of perception and knowledge also extended to vision, natural science, religion, and questions of social life.

bio.zh: 休谟是苏格兰哲学家、历史学家与散文家。他以对人性的研究考察知识、情感和道德，分析因果推断与习惯的关系，并追问理性的限度。他强调情感和同情在道德判断中的作用，其研究也延伸到宗教、政治经济和英国历史。
bio.en: David Hume was a Scottish philosopher, historian, and essayist. His study of human nature explored understanding, emotion, and morality, examining the role of habit in causal inference and the limits of reason. He investigated how sentiment and sympathy inform moral judgment, and extended his work to religion, political economy, and the history of England.

works.en: An Enquiry Concerning the Principles of Morals
